item.title: Webflow: IT Support Specialist
item.description:
Headquarters: Argentina Remote

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

Webflow is looking for an IT Support Specialist to be the hands-on technical presence in our Buenos Aires office. You'll be the first line of support for employees, resolving tickets through our help desk using state of the art, AI powered support tooling, while also owning the technology that makes our office run and our biggest moments land. You'll partner closely with our Workplace Experience team for on site builds or modifications. This is a role for someone who's energized by variety and has a desire to help create valuable experiences for Webflow employees.

About the role:

  • Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina (Hybrid 1–3 days per week in office)
  • Full-time
  • Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)
  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for a new position

  • Reporting to the Senior Director, Information Technology

As an IT Support Specialist, you’ll …

  • Resolve employee tickets through our help desk, leveraging AI powered support tooling to triage, troubleshoot, and close issues efficiently
  • Make our AI powered tooling even better by documenting common issues, fixes, and processes to build out our internal knowledge base 
  • Own audio visual setup at the office 
  • Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues across macOS devices, peripherals, and office technology
  • Partner with the Workplace Experience team on ordering and provisioning equipment and supporting our office space
  • Serve as a backup resource for IT onboarding support during new hire cohorts, as needed
  • Provide local support for our Argentina based workforce
  • Maintain hardware and software inventory, where necessary
  • Escalate complex issues to the right internal teams and follow through to resolution

About you:

Requiriments

  • 2-4 years of hands-on experience with help desk ticketing systems
  • Skilled in using AI-powered tools to work efficiently such as MM&MM
  • Familiar with supporting audiovisual setups for meetings, presentations, and larger events
  • Comfortable troubleshooting macOS environments
  • Proficient in new hire onboarding, including account setup, hardware provisioning and day-one enablement
  • Ability to perform physical, in-office work such as setting up desks, provisioning equipment, and helping stand up new office spaces and lift up to 20lbs
  • Available to work full-time from our Buenos Aires office, with potential travel to other office locations and occasional work from home

You’ll thrive as an IT Support Specialist if you:

  • Bring genuine warmth to every interaction with a desire to help
  • Communicate clearly and patiently with employees
  • Enjoy variety and can shift gears between tickets, AV, and hands on office work without missing a beat
  • Are flexible, knowing that some weeks look like steady ticket work and others mean adjusting your schedule around an event
  • Take pride in the small details that make an office feel like it just works
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. 
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Remote, together

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor. 

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

item.title: 6sense: Manager, Customer Success - Upmarket
item.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

The Role

As a Manager, Customer Success, you will lead a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers responsible for a combined portfolio of Upmarket customers with annual contract values ranging from $100K to $500K and representing approximately $15M-$20M in ARR.

You will be responsible for driving customer retention, adoption, customer value realization, and operational excellence across your team's portfolio while developing and coaching a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers. This role requires a strong people leader who can balance business performance, talent development, forecasting discipline, and customer outcomes.

Success in this role requires the ability to develop top talent, create accountability, establish operational rigor, and partner cross-functionally to ensure customers realize measurable business value from their investment in 6sense.

You will work closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to help customers achieve their goals while contributing to the continued growth and scale of the Customer Success organization.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers supporting Upmarket customers.
  • Create a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, talent assessments, and career development conversations.
  • Establish clear expectations and operating rhythms that drive consistent execution and customer outcomes.
  • Recruit, onboard, and develop Customer Success talent while supporting succession planning across the organization.
  • Inspire and motivate a team that consistently delivers exceptional customer experiences and business results.

Drive Customer Success Outcomes

  • Lead a team responsible for customers with annual contract values between $100K and $500K and a combined portfolio of approximately $15M-$20M in ARR.
  • Drive strong Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), customer adoption, customer satisfaction, and value realization across the portfolio.
  • Coach Customer Success Managers on account strategy, executive stakeholder engagement, success planning, renewal strategy, risk mitigation, and value delivery, ensuring they understand and own the renewal process.
  • Ensure Customer Success Managers proactively identify customer risks and execute strategies to improve retention outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to align on customer health, growth opportunities, and strategic account planning.
  • Drive a high level of customer engagement and executive alignment across key accounts.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Own portfolio forecasting processes, renewal inspections, customer health reviews, and risk management practices.
  • Ensure consistent execution of success plans, Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), account reviews, and customer engagement standards.
  • Use data and analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and drive informed decision-making.
  • Drive adoption of Customer Success processes, tools, and best practices across the team.
  • Champion initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, forecast accuracy, and customer outcomes.

Partner Across the Business

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Professional Services, Support, Marketing, and RevOps to deliver a world-class customer experience.
  • Act as a voice of the customer and advocate for customer needs across the organization.
  • Support strategic initiatives focused on customer retention, product adoption, operational scale, and customer value realization.
  • Help shape the future of Customer Success programs, processes, and operating models as the business continues to grow.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of people leadership experience leading customer-facing teams within a SaaS organization.
  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, or other customer-facing roles.
  • Proven track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for customer retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models and key metrics, including GRR, churn, forecasting, customer health, and product adoption.
  • Experience coaching teams on executive engagement, account strategy, value realization, and risk management.
  • Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive operational rigor and accountability through data-driven management practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into action.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools and workflows to improve team productivity, customer insights, coaching effectiveness, and operational scale.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, team events, and company programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading Customer Success teams supporting enterprise or upmarket SaaS customers.
  • Experience managing teams responsible for portfolios between $15M and $20M in ARR.
  • Experience within MarTech, AdTech, SalesTech, Revenue Technology, or related B2B SaaS industries.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari, Gong, and other customer success technologies.
  • Experience helping scale Customer Success organizations, teams, and operating models.

Why 6sense

At 6sense, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, influence the future of Customer Success, and directly impact customer retention and business outcomes across a diverse portfolio of Upmarket customers.

You'll work alongside some of the industry's most innovative leaders while helping customers transform how they identify, engage, and convert buyers. You'll have the autonomy to make an impact, the support of a world-class leadership team, and the opportunity to grow your career while developing the next generation of Customer Success talent.

If you're passionate about building great teams, creating exceptional customer outcomes, and helping scale a world-class Customer Success organization, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Base Salary Range: $113,400-150,100. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy

Our Benefits: 

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. 

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com. 

We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

item.title: Hightouch: Deployment Architect
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote (North America)

About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

About The Role 

As an Deployment Architect, you will be the force behind successful deployments at Hightouch. Working in close partnership with an account team and the Hightouch product team, you will own the full deployment and enablement lifecycle for Hightouch customers. You will be the primary point of contact for customers during deployment and are responsible for executing the technical aspects of customer onboarding, ensuring seamless integration of Hightouch into customers' existing data infrastructure.

In this role, you will be the product expert who translates complex customer requirements into actionable implementation plans. You should have a natural ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both data engineering teams and business stakeholders. As the primary owner of the deployment lifecycle, your focus is on creating repeatable, efficient implementation processes that scale across our customer base while maintaining the flexibility to address unique enterprise needs.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive the onboarding process for customers, working closely with the Account team to ensure alignment between technical execution and customer success objectives
  • Design and optimize deployment frameworks that can scale across different customer segments while accommodating enterprise-specific requirements
  • Lead technical discovery sessions and implementation workshops, collaborating with customer data engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for deployments, including integration specifications, data models, and best practices
  • Develop and execute implementation plans that minimize time-to-value while ensuring robust, sustainable solutions
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and resolve technical blockers that could impact customer success
  • Build relationships with technical stakeholders within customer organizations
  • Contribute to product development by providing feedback to our engineering team
  • Standardize and automate implementation processes to increase team efficiency and customer satisfaction

What We're Looking For

  • 5-10 years of experience in technical implementation, solutions architecture, or similar roles with enterprise software
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in data integration, APIs, and enterprise architecture
  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex technical implementations while maintaining clear communication with a variety of stakeholders
  • The ability to tackle the most ambiguous customer problems (the "that can't be done" ones) and find a creative paths to successful implementation
  • Experience creating and optimizing implementation processes that can scale across an organization
  • Excellence in technical project management with ability to manage multiple concurrent implementations
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills with ability to command a room of technical and business audiences
  • Experience working with data warehouses, ETL processes, and marketing technology is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience)

The salary range for this position is $140,000-$180,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation.

Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

item.title: Shout About Us: Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships
item.skills: API, Client Relationship Management, Communication Skills, Relationship Building, and REST APIs
item.description:
Headquarters: San Diego, CA, USA
URL: http://www.shoutaboutus.com

Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships

Shout About Us · Remote (worldwide) · Full-time · 60K - 80K USD

About the role

We're hiring a Technical Account Manager to own and grow our most strategic accounts. You’ll own the technical relationship with our API partners, from their first technical evaluation through implementation and ongoing support.

Reporting directly to the CRO, you’ll be the first dedicated post-sales professional at Shout About Us, responsible for making sure our biggest customers deploy, expand, and stay. Our ICP is founders, product teams, and engineering teams. 

This is a hands-on role. On any given day, you might join a prospect’s technical discovery call, troubleshoot an API request with a partner engineer, coordinate a fix with our engineering team, or improve a quickstart guide. You’ll also help build the documentation and processes that make each new integration easier than the last.

Location and hours

Remote, anywhere. Our standard working hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. US Eastern Time, including a lunch break. Occasional calls outside these hours are required for APAC partners and key implementation milestones.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of 10-15 strategic accounts. Be the primary technical contact for API partners, keep stakeholders informed, and follow issues through to resolution.

  • Support technical evaluations. Join sales calls, demonstrate API capabilities, understand the partner’s requirements, and explain how an integration would work.

  • Lead partner implementations. Turn requirements into a clear integration plan, guide developers through setup and testing, and track progress through launch.

  • Troubleshoot directly. Investigate requests, responses, logs, authentication issues, and integration behavior before escalating to engineering.

  • Work closely with engineering. Provide clear reproduction steps, relevant evidence, and customer impact when an issue needs deeper investigation.

  • Improve the developer experience. Create and maintain API guides, Postman collections, code examples, FAQs, and onboarding playbooks.

  • Identify recurring friction. Share partner feedback and integration patterns that can inform product improvements.

  • Lead expansion efforts. Cross-sell new features and products as a natural extension of the relationship, not a separate motion. 

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role or equivalent at an API-first or dev-tools company

  • Strong practical understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, authentication, webhooks, pagination, and rate limits.

  • Comfort using Postman or curl, reading logs, and writing or adapting small code examples in a language such as JavaScript or Python.

  • Experience driving adoption inside complex orgs: navigating the gap between the buyer who signed and the team that deploys

  • Strong follow-through. You keep track of open questions, set expectations, and make sure customers know what happens next.

  • Startup experience at a company under 50 people. There's no support team behind you.

  • Clear written and spoken English. You can explain the same issue to a developer and a nontechnical stakeholder.

  • Owner mentality. "I'll make sure this gets done," not "I passed it to engineering."

Why you should join

  • Own meaningful partner relationships from technical evaluation through launch and beyond.

  • See the impact of your work in successful integrations and better customer experiences.

  • You’ll own and drive every initiative you work on from start to finish. We fully trust you.

  • Work remotely from anywhere while collaborating on a shared schedule.

  • Work directly with the people selling and building the product.

Why you shouldn't join

  • You are not comfortable working without a clear structure and playbook. 

  • You need predictable hours. Most weeks are normal. Go-live weeks and APAC escalations aren't.

Interview process

Our process includes an introductory call, a short written exercise, a practical technical session, and a final conversation with our CEO. We’ll share the details and expected time commitment before each step.

About Shout About Us

Shout About Us is API-first review infrastructure for marketplaces and platforms.

Reviews are the most valuable decision signal in every transaction: which agent, which contractor, which property, which restaurant. Almost every platform that hosts those decisions rents that signal from Google, Trustpilot or Yelp. We give platforms the APIs and infrastructure to own it.

What you can build with our APIs:

  • A verified first-party review engine: collection, verification, moderation and publishing under your brand

  • Third-party review aggregation from Google, Yelp, Facebook and 80+ other sources

  • AI review responses drafted and posted natively, without your customers leaving your platform

  • Review solicitation and surveys triggered from events in your product

  • Flagging, disputes, AI insight reports and competitor analysis

We’re a small team looking for someone who can make it easier for partners to understand, integrate, and succeed with our API.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/shout-about-us-technical-account-manager-api-partnerships

item.title: Dropbox: Customer Evidence Manager
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada: Select locations

Role Description

Dropbox is hiring a Customer Evidence Manager to own and drive the customer-proof infrastructure that powers our managed sales motion. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercially minded, creatively grounded customer marketer who understands that the value of a customer story is not that it gets published — it is that it protects customer trust, gives buyers credible, accurate proof and moves a deal forward. You are the editorial authority on what good looks like, not the person writing every script: execution (writing, video, design) is delivered through agency partners you brief and direct.

Enterprise buyers do not decide on brand claims. They decide on credible proof from organizations like theirs: customer stories, ROI evidence, video testimonials, peer reviews, and competitive validation. In this role, you will produce that evidence and ensure it reaches sellers and customers at the moments it can have the greatest commercial impact.

You will own the program outcomes and operational rigor — setting the creative and editorial bar for what makes a great customer story, directing the agency partners who produce the work, and deploying that proof into active deals — and measuring evidence's impact on pipeline, win rates, and sales-cycle velocity. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Campaign Enablement, and product teams to prioritize proof for the full suite of Dropbox products and solutions, including  AI capabilities, multi-product platform adoption, and priority vertical workflows. You will get substantial senior Sales and Marketing leadership exposure and a direct, measurable line to revenue during a pivotal shift in how Dropbox goes to market.

Responsibilities

  • Identify advocates, coordinate outreach with account teams, manage consent and approvals, record participation preferences, and avoid customer fatigue. 
  • Set the creative and editorial direction and maintain the evidence taxonomy, freshness, and discoverability of the asset library — case studies, ROI studies, video testimonials, peer/G2 reviews, customer voice, and competitive proof.
  • Manage the sales content library (Highspot, Deeto, or comparable) — organize assets by deal stage, customer profile, vertical, and product; set and enforce freshness standards; and proactively surface content gaps.
  • Run a recurring Sales–Marketing feedback session to understand seller needs, assess content performance in live deals, and prioritize new evidence.
  • Ensure the right proof reaches the right seller for the right deal stage proactively, and track evidence utilization by account executive and deal stage to close adoption gaps.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to build campaign attribution and reporting in Salesforce, measuring evidence's influence on pipeline, win rate, and sales-cycle velocity.
  • Provide monthly reporting to Sales and Marketing on evidence performance and pipeline acceleration, and maintain a rolling pipeline of customers at each stage of evidence development.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in B2B content marketing, customer marketing, or sales enablement — ideally spanning all three.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating a customer evidence, case-study, or advocacy program that sellers actively used in live sales cycles (not solely a published content library).
  • Strong command of complex B2B sales cycles and the specific evidence needed at each stage, from discovery and evaluation through procurement and legal review.
  • Direct experience partnering with account executives and SDRs to produce commercially effective content and enablement.
  • A creative/editorial background with strong instincts for what makes a compelling customer story and credible social proof — able to set the bar, write briefs, direct and manage agency partners, and edit to a high standard (rather than personally produce every asset), while managing multiple stories and stakeholders at once.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with Highspot, Seismic, DocSend, or a comparable sales content platform.
  • Experience with Salesforce campaign attribution, pipeline reporting, or closely related revenue analytics — able to connect content performance to business outcomes.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or managed sales motions in a SaaS environment.
  • Experience developing customer proof for AI products, workflow products, or multi-product platform adoption.
  • Familiarity with G2 or other peer-review programs, and with GEO / customer-voice strategy.
  • Experience partnering with Marketing Operations/Campaign Enablement/ Marketing Data Science on content attribution and sales-content analytics.
  • Experience developing evidence for priority verticals (e.g. marketing and creative and Architecture, Engineering and Construction.)

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

Canada Pay Range
$142,800—$193,200 CAD

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Have familiarity with the Dutch and Nordic markets

On-Target Earnings Pay Range
€139.000—€170.000 EUR

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. 

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

  • GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.
  • TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.
  • CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.
  • CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.
  • HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice

  • Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page.
  • All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an @algolia.com email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an @algolia.com email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.
  • We’ll never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details during the hiring process.

READY TO APPLY?

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!

item.description:
Headquarters: US-Florida
URL: https://iti-digital.com/

Role Overview

ITI Digital is seeking a Client Success Manager to serve as the primary relationship manager for a diverse portfolio of clients across our DXP platform and managed destination websites. This portfolio includes Destination Management Organizations (DMOs), regional tourism boards, Chambers of Commerce, parks & recreation departments, government agencies, and economic development organizations. A background working with or for these types of organizations is central to this role.

This is an active, day-to-day account management position. The Client Success Manager personally conducts onboarding calls, manages ongoing client engagements, monitors product adoption, and leads the renewal process. The role owns a defined core book of accounts directly and provides day-to-day direction to a small team of Client Success Specialists across the team's combined account portfolio. In addition to direct account responsibilities, this role contributes to process refinement and serves as an internal representative of client needs in product and strategy discussions. This is a hands-on, collaborative role rather than a removed management position.

Preferred Background

The ideal candidate brings direct familiarity with the organizations ITI Digital serves, along with an understanding of the digital tools that support them. Relevant experience may include one or more of the following:

  • Experience within a Destination Management or Marketing Organization (DMO), government agency, or economic development organization in a marketing, digital, or partnership capacity

  • Experience selling marketing services, digital platforms, or SaaS solutions to destinations, tourism boards, parks & recreation departments, government agencies, or economic development organizations from an agency or vendor perspective

  • Familiarity with co-op programs, visitor guide campaigns, itinerary tools, virtual visitor centers, or digital engagement platforms used by public-sector or destination marketing organizations

  • An understanding of the operational environment of public-sector and quasi-public organizations, including board reporting cycles, grant-funded budgets, fiscal year planning, and multi-stakeholder decision-making processes

  • A genuine understanding of how these organizations operate — and the ability to translate that understanding into thoughtful, consultative account management — will be a distinguishing quality in this role

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales-to-CS Handoff & CRM Stewardship

This area of responsibility focuses on ensuring a smooth transition from Sales and maintaining accurate data across client management systems.

  • Maintain CRM company and deal records up-to-date with client information; flag gaps and align with Sales as needed

  • Manage the client management platform configuration, including lifecycle stages, health scores, and onboarding playbooks

  • Lead periodic reviews of the client management platform database to ensure accuracy, clean segmentation, and up-to-date client records

  • Serve as the primary CS point of contact for platform questions, configuration updates, and vendor best practices

2. New Client Onboarding Ownership

The Client Success Manager is responsible for guiding new clients through a structured, milestone-driven onboarding process across our DXP platform and managed destination websites.

  • Conduct welcome calls and kickoff meetings, drawing on destination industry experience to establish meaningful rapport with clients

  • Clarify package scope, delivery timelines, and client-side resource commitments in accessible, straightforward terms

  • Coordinate with Implementation and Technical Support specialists to track milestone completion; escalate blockers proactively

  • Provide product demonstrations tailored to client use cases, connecting features to real workflows relevant to the client's organization type

  • Deliver a formal end-of-onboarding notification and satisfaction survey; document lessons learned for playbook improvement

3. Subscription Engagement & Product Adoption Strategy & Support

This area of responsibility centers on developing and sustaining strong client relationships throughout the subscription period, with a focus on long-term engagement and product adoption.

  • Maintain direct ownership of an assigned core book spanning DMOs, government agencies, Parks & Recreation departments, and economic development organizations across their full subscription terms

  • Conduct regular check-in cadences calibrated to client tier and account health

  • Apply relevant industry knowledge to connect product features to client outcomes, including visitor center engagement metrics, grant reporting requirements, economic development KPIs, and co-op partner ROI

  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and hand off to the Sales team for follow-through

  • Proactively identify accounts showing signs of declining usage or key contact changes, and respond with appropriate education or outreach

  • Share relevant case studies, benchmark data, and best practices from across the ITI Digital client base to support adoption

  • Serve as an internal advocate for clients during product development discussions, translating sector-specific feedback into actionable product input

4. Client Health Monitoring & Risk Management

The Client Success Manager is expected to maintain a consistent, informed view of account health, identifying and addressing risks before they affect client satisfaction or retention.

  • Maintain health scores in the client management platform using usage data, survey results, support ticket patterns, and relationship signals

  • Conduct structured health-check conversations at defined intervals, especially during leadership transitions at client organizations

  • Deploy satisfaction survey campaigns at key subscription milestones; analyze results and close the feedback loop with clients

  • Classify at-risk accounts on early indicators — passive satisfaction, declining usage, key contact changes, budget or procurement signals, and client unresponsiveness — not solely on expressed dissatisfaction, and maintain a documented save plan for each

  • Log client-reported technical issues and escalate for triage and engineering assignment

  • Escalate at-risk accounts to leadership with a clear situation summary, documented save plan, and recommended course of action well ahead of the renewal date

 5. Renewal Management

Renewal management is a primary accountability of the Client Success Manager. This role carries direct responsibility for retained revenue across the assigned portfolio.

  • Maintain a current, accurate renewal pipeline with visibility into upcoming contract end dates

  • Initiate renewal conversations well in advance of contract end; identify and address concerns early to avoid late-stage risk

  • Apply approved concession parameters for renewal negotiations; escalate any offer outside those boundaries prior to client communication

  • Prepare renewal contracts (with admin support); track signature status and follow up as needed

  • Escalate contract, pricing, or invoicing concerns to leadership with full account context and a recommended course of action

6. Team Collaboration, Coaching & Continuous Improvement

The Client Success Manager works closely with a small team of Client Success Specialists, providing day-to-day guidance, sharing best practices, and helping to ensure consistent quality across the team's client interactions.

  • Provide day-to-day direction and support to Client Success Specialists, including guidance on client communication, issue resolution, and account management best practices

  • Serve as a resource for the Specialists when navigating complex client situations, escalations, or unfamiliar account types

  • Partner with Implementation, Technical Support, and relevant internal teams to resolve client issues that fall outside standard support workflows

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of onboarding and adoption playbooks, drawing on direct client experience across the full portfolio

  • Contribute relevant sector knowledge to internal conversations regarding product roadmap, marketing, and sales positioning

  • Uphold consistent standards in client communication, documentation, and CRM data management, and support the Specialists in doing the same

Ideal Candidate Profile

The following characteristics describe the professional qualities ITI Digital is seeking in this role:

  • Dependable — consistently reliable in following through on commitments to clients and colleagues

  • Collaborative — willing to share knowledge and provide informal guidance to colleagues in a team-oriented environment

  • Consultative — approaches client relationships with careful listening and thoughtful problem-solving

  • Sector-fluent — familiar with the operational and planning cycles of DMOs, government agencies, and economic development organizations, including board governance, grant budgets, and public accountability structures

  • Tech-curious — interested in SaaS and digital platforms, with a willingness to develop fluency in new tools

  • Detail-oriented — attentive to the accuracy and thoroughness required in CRM management, milestone tracking, and contract administration

  • Adaptable — comfortable navigating shifting priorities in a growing organization

  • Autonomous — able to exercise sound independent judgment while knowing when to involve leadership

  • Composed under pressure — maintains professionalism and perspective in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Position Details

  • Location: Fully remote — US Eastern Time Zone (8 AM – 5 PM ET). Reliable computer and internet connection required. Candidates located in the US Eastern or Central Time Zone are preferred.

  • Work Schedule: Full-time exempt position. Standard hours: 8:00 am–5:00 pm EST. Minimum 40 hours per week. Additional time may be required based on business needs.

  • Employment Type: Contract-to-hire 1099, with a 90-day evaluation period. Successful completion converts to Full-Time W2 with benefits.

  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience. Compensation is determined based on factors including relevant experience, demonstrated qualifications, and geographic location.

  • Reports To: VP, Digital Strategy

  • Platform Communication/Systems: Slack, Zoom, Google Meet, and CRM/project management tools, such as Vitally CS, HubSpot, Asana, JIRA, and Freshdesk.

ITI Digital is an equal opportunity employer.

item.description:
Headquarters: Tampa, Florida
URL: https://koast.ai

Head of Technical Support | Full-time | Remote (US hours) | Reports to the CEO

Koast is the AI operating layer for teams that run Meta ads at volume. Agencies, in-house media buying teams, and enterprise buyers managing 10+ ad accounts and launching 50+ ads a week use Koast to launch faster, automate optimizations off real attribution data, and see every account from one Command Center. The Koast Agent is the next layer: an AI that reads the account, spots what matters, and acts inside guardrails.

Our customers are media buyers. When something breaks, it is not a support ticket to them. It is a campaign that did not launch, a budget that did not move, or an account they cannot see. They need someone on the other end who has run ads, knows what they are looking at, and can tell the difference between a Meta API error, a user mistake, and a real bug.

That is this role. You are the anchor between our customers and our engineers. You will onboard every new account, own every ticket, QA every release before it hits production, and make sure engineering hears about patterns, not anecdotes.

What You WIll Own...

Onboarding. Every new customer gets set up right the first time: ad accounts connected, attribution (Hyros, Cometly) wired in, team invited, first launch done together on a call. You will run these sessions yourself, then build the playbook and the in-app flow so the next hundred customers need less of you.

Support, end to end. Intercom is yours. Response times, resolution quality, the help center, the macros, the escalation path. You will answer tickets yourself until the volume justifies a hire, and you will know every customer by name before you delegate a single one.

Triage and the bridge to engineering. You decide what is a bug, what is a feature gap, what is Meta being Meta, and what is user error. Bugs get reproduced, documented with steps and account context, and filed in Shortcut with enough detail that an engineer can fix it without asking you a follow-up question. Patterns get surfaced in the weekly review with numbers: how many customers, how much spend affected, how often.

QA and release quality. Nothing ships to production without you having run it against a real ad account. You will own the QA pass on every release: launch flows, automations, Agent actions, integrations. You know what a broken campaign structure looks like in Ads Manager, and you catch it before a customer does.

System tightness. Meta API connections, token refreshes, webhook health, Whop account provisioning, attribution syncs. You will monitor them (Sentry, PostHog, internal dashboards), notice when something drifts, and get it fixed before it turns into a ticket.

Customer health and retention. You will know which accounts are launching, which have gone quiet, and which are about to churn. You will bring that list to the CEO weekly and you will own the outreach.

What you will do week to week

  • Run onboarding calls for new customers and enterprise accounts. Connect accounts, verify data, launch the first campaign together.
  • Work the Intercom queue. Own first response, resolution, and follow-up.
  • Reproduce every reported bug against a real ad account before it goes to engineering.
  • File and prioritize Shortcut tickets with repro steps, account IDs, screenshots, and expected versus actual behavior.
  • QA each release candidate against a test account and a live customer scenario. Sign off or send it back.
  • Monitor Sentry and PostHog for errors and drop-offs. Flag anything that affects more than one customer the same day.
  • Run the weekly support review: ticket volume by category, time to resolution, top three patterns, customers at risk. One page, numbers first.
  • Write help center articles and Loom walkthroughs for anything you have explained more than twice.

What sets you apart

  • You have run Meta ads. You know Ads Manager, campaign and ad set structure, learning phase, Advantage+, pixel and CAPI setup, and what "the API rejected my creative" actually means. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.
  • You have done support or customer success for a B2B SaaS product and you were the person engineers trusted because your bug reports were correct.
  • You can QA software. You have written test cases, run release checks, and sent a build back because it was not ready.
  • You are calm with a frustrated customer whose launch just failed, and you are direct with an engineer who shipped the thing that failed it.
  • You write tightly. Your tickets, your help articles, and your customer replies are shorter than everyone else's and clearer.
  • You want to build the support function, not just work inside one.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in customer support, customer success, or technical support for a B2B SaaS product, including at least one role where you were the primary bridge to engineering.
  • Hands-on Meta ads experience. You have managed ad accounts, launched campaigns, and troubleshot Ads Manager and API issues. Agency or performance marketing background strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Intercom or a comparable support platform, and a ticketing or project tool (Shortcut, Linear, Jira).
  • Experience running QA or UAT on software releases.
  • Comfortable reading logs, API responses, and error monitoring (Sentry or similar). You do not need to write code. You need to read enough to know where the problem is.
  • Familiarity with attribution tools (Hyros, Cometly, Triple Whale, Northbeam) is a plus.
  • Available full-time during US business hours.

How You Work

Small team, high autonomy. Decisions are made with numbers, written down, and revisited when the numbers change. These are the values we run on. If they sound like you, you will fit right in.

  • Mastery. "Good enough" is where you start, not where you stop. You keep sharpening the craft: tighter repros, faster resolutions, fewer repeat tickets.
  • Push the Boundaries. You take on the ambitious version of the problem. Most support teams answer tickets. You want to build the one that prevents them.
  • Embrace the Challenge. When a customer's launch breaks at 9pm, you are in the thread, not waiting for the morning standup.
  • Responsibility. You own your commitments. If a fix slips, the customer hears it from you first, with a new date attached.
  • Dedication. You dive into the hard, unglamorous problems (an intermittent API error, a broken sync nobody can reproduce) and iterate until they are solved.
  • Collaboration. You write clearly, share what you learn, and make engineering and sales faster for having worked with you.

Why Koast

  • Early-stage impact. You will be one of the first ten full-time employees. The support function, the onboarding playbook, and the QA standard will be the ones you built.
  • AI and ads at scale. You will support some of the highest-volume ad teams on Meta and see what an AI agent does with real budgets every day.
  • Real compensation. Full-time salary, performance bonuses tied to retention and resolution metrics, and paid time off. Bootstrapped and profitable, so the seat is stable and the growth path is real.
  • Remote and flexible. Work from anywhere, on your schedule, during US hours. Just make sure every customer is launching.

How to apply

Record a Loom, five minutes or less, covering these four things in order:

  1. Explain why you're a fit. Screen-share and explain projects youve worked on, ad accounts you have had access to (blur what you need) or companies you helped before. Walk us through the structure and tell us the last thing that broke in it and how you fixed it.
  2. One bug report. Take us through an example of a report you filed that an engineer fixed without asking you a follow-up question. Tell us how you reproduced it.
  3. Your experience with Meta. How deep does your knoweldge run around Meta's API and ad product?

Email the Loom link and your LinkedIn or resume to jobs@koast.ai with the subject line "Retention is king".

NOTE: DO NOT APPLY IF YOU HAVE NO EXPERIENCE WITH PRODUCTS LIKE THIS / ADVERTISING / CANNOT WORK US HOURS.

No cover letters. We watch the Loom first and read the resume second. Applications without the video are not reviewed.

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

Our values: 

We make a positive impact.

We aim for the stars.

Impact of a Customer Retention Manager

As our Customer Retention Manager, you play a key role in protecting and growing revenue across a high-volume portfolio of customer accounts. Your day-to-day is proactive, human outreach and health monitoring — building real relationships at scale, bringing a human touch to segments that are often managed purely through automation, and catching risk early. When you manage that well, renewal conversations become a natural next step rather than the main event. You'll also work within the workflows, health scoring, automation, and segmentation that let retention scale without creating internal chaos, all while keeping the renewal experience smart, timely, and low-friction.

Reporting to our VP, Customer Success, this role is ideal for someone who loves building, improving processes, testing ideas, and seeing direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to inform retention strategy and engagement models across the business.

What to expect

  • Renewal Ownership & Pipeline Management: Manage a rolling pipeline of customer renewals across a high-volume portfolio, initiating conversations ahead of contract expiration and driving each account through to close.

  • Retention Workflow Support: Help build and improve scalable retention and renewal workflows using Salesforce and integrated tooling, contributing to repeatable processes that hold up as portfolio volume grows.

  • Proactive Relationship Building: Own direct, human outreach to smaller and long-tail accounts by proactively building relationships with them.

  • Lifecycle & Tech-Touch Design: Contribute to the design of customer lifecycle journeys, engagement triggers, and tech-touch motions 

  • Health Scoring & Risk Identification: Use customer health scoring frameworks- built on usage, engagement, and lifecycle signals- to identify at-risk accounts early, partnering with internal stakeholders to develop and execute save strategies.

  • Automation & AI Enablement: Support the implementation of automated outreach, lifecycle campaigns, and renewal risk workflows, and flag opportunities to leverage AI and automation.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and multi-year agreements within established company guidelines.

  • Expansion Identification: Partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Executives to identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities during the renewal cycle.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to support and inform retention strategy and customer engagement models.

What you bring

  • Renewal Lifecycle Experience: Experience managing a rolling renewal pipeline, engaging customers well in advance of contract expiration.

  • Commercial Negotiation Skills: Experience negotiating pricing, contract terms, and multi-year agreements within established guidelines.

  • Risk Identification & Save Strategy: Ability to identify at-risk accounts early and collaborate cross-functionally on save strategies.

  • CRM & Systems Experience: Hands-on experience working within Salesforce or a similar CRM, including contributing to operational workflows or lifecycle processes.

  • Retention & Lifecycle Knowledge: Solid understanding of customer health scoring, lifecycle automation, and retention strategy.

  • Expansion Mindset: Proven ability to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities in partnership with CSMs and Account Executives.

  • Versatility: Comfort operating across both customer-facing engagement conversations and systems/process design conversations.

  • Growth Mindset: Demonstrates a sustained commitment to continuous improvement, actively seeking out better ways to engage customers and support scalable operations.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in the UK, France, Spain, Germany or Canada. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. 

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.   

You can expect 4 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (VP, Customer Success)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (IC's)
  4. 45 Minutes with Executive (COO)

All roles require background checks.
